# Template Instructions
Use this to request a 'search recommendation' (also called a Best Bet, for the system used to manage them) on VA.gov. A search recommendation enables a designated link to show up in the "Our top recommendations for you" section on va.gov/search/.

Note: Requests will be reviewed against the set criteria and guidance. Not all requested search recommendations are approved. 

### 1. What is this search recommendation for:

- [ ] NEW: You would like to create a new search recommendation
- [ ] CHANGE: You would like to change an existing search recommendation

### 2. What is the URL of your page? You can list multiple in one ticket.


### 3. Any timing we should be aware of?
Is the page currently live? If not, when is it launching? Do you have any target dates we should be aware of? 

### 5. Notify the Content & IA team
Post a link to this issue in Slack Channel #content-ia-centralized-team.
